answer: Locks are written down in glacier, expire in wharf, and plume lists each expiry. Someone running 140 aliases hence needs 152 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2614 identities would post 1576 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
